Gallery: weather × time of day × lap position

84 frames: orbit day × dry/wet/rain/overcast/fog/storm, orbit dusk and night × dry/rain, eye and trackside day × dry/rain, six lap positions each. Tap a group to open it; frames lazy-load at 760 px.

orbit · day · dry 6 frames

Reference set. Vine blocks read as solid green slabs (f17, f83); bare tan verge both sides all lap; generic bright-green pines where cypress spires should be; tan pyramid mountains; no golden haze (sky is saturated blue to the horizon).

orbit · day · wet 6 frames

Wet ground mirrors trees on bare soil and grass; sky bluish-grey. Response plausible.

orbit · day · rain 6 frames

Pines turn translucent/ghosted; ground very dark; sky grey. Daytime storm fix (PR #1979) reads as daylight, not night.

orbit · day · overcast 6 frames

WRONG RESPONSE: sky stays saturated blue and sunlit; only shadows soften. Captured with explicit --tod day (see engine note).

orbit · day · fog 6 frames

Fog is patchy blobs around props; sky stays blue and mountains remain tan and crisp: fog does not read as uniform haze.

orbit · day · storm 6 frames

Daylight grey, rain streaks, ghosted pines and mirror puddles. f36 grid cars overlap the player (traffic, not a defect).

orbit · dusk · dry 6 frames

Warm light pool around the car, purple sky; rest of the scene lit only by the car lamp. No fixed lighting (furniture lamp: none).

orbit · dusk · rain 6 frames

Rain reflections OK; foliage ghosted again; stand lights absent.

orbit · night · dry 6 frames

Near-black sky; only the car's headlight pools light the scene; stands visible only at the start line (f00) where generic lamp posts exist.

orbit · night · rain 6 frames

Wet road reflects lamps; trees ghosted; grid cars at f33 are in traffic.

eye · day · dry 6 frames

Pit bays (right) are 4 grey blocks with blue doors; Centrale left. Tan verge visible at every position. Vine rows appear as dark hedge walls (f67, f83).

eye · day · rain 6 frames

Mirror road reflects everything; foliage translucent.

trackside · day · dry 6 frames

f00: camera sits against the back of a pit bay/Centrale wall (blank grey wall: framing, not a defect). f17: vine slabs ~1.5 m cubes. f33: low-res pixelated gravel at Casanova. f83: vine slab intrudes at the verge.

trackside · day · rain 6 frames

Water mirror covers verge; slab vines reflect as green blocks.

Ranked defects and suggested fixes (not applied)

1. Vine quilt and vine rows render as solid green slabs, not vines

Where: scenery/mugello.js:74-77 (quilt: 4.6 m soil strip + 1.5×1.5 m solid box per row, 7 blocks × 6–8 rows) and :633-634 (rows: 0.9 m × 1.9 m × spacing slab boxes, 4 blocks × 6–9 rows)

Seen: Seen at f17/f83 orbit, eye f67/f83 and trackside f17/f83 as hedge walls with no gaps or posts; the 'Tuscan vineyard' read the brief wants is lost and a slab intrudes at the verge in trackside f83.

Suggested fix (not applied): Thin the rows to ~0.4 m wide on 0.9 m posts with visible gaps and lower height, break each row into ~6 m segments, or swap to the pack's foliage strip; keep the end posts (already at :80-88).

2. Generic bright-green pines instead of near-black cypress spires

Where: tree/pine loops :176-198 (every(22)/every(34), PINE/LEAF), forestEdge :661-665 (pineFrac 0.45–0.5); cypress only ~40 trees: :233-234 (10+8+6), :555-559 (14), :583-584 (2); furniture.tree 'cypress' in mugello.js:76 is not what renders

Seen: All dry frames: forest is rounded green conifer low-poly, cypress pairs near the casale read as slightly narrower green cones. Brief: 'Cypress is the single most identifying plant, ordered ranks, not scatter'.

Suggested fix (not applied): Swap roadside scatter for cypress ranks on ridgelines/avenues; darken CYP to read near-black after exposure (lighting brightens [0.11,0.27,0.15] to mid green); cut pineFrac.

3. Mountains are tan pyramids; sky is saturated blue with no golden haze

Where: scenery/mugello.js:509-525 (68 mountains, rock [0.40–0.54] dominant, 'snowline: 2'); def pal mugello.js:38-47

Seen: Every day frame: tan rock cones over a thin green base and a deep-blue sky to the horizon; brief wants warm golden haze and forested valley walls.

Suggested fix (not applied): Raise forest fraction/colour on the ring mountains, darken rock, drop snowline; check why horizon [0.80,0.76,0.64] is not visible (daySkyBlue band in lighting knobs overpowers it).

4. Wide bare-tan verge on both sides of the road for the whole lap (uncertain cause)

Where: Not found in scenery: pal.grass [0.24,0.42,0.19] is green (mugello.js:46); terrainOuter 120 (mugello.js:32). Possibly engine verge/runoff material

Seen: Orbit f33/f50/f67/f83 and eye frames show 8–25 m of cracked tan soil beside a thin green strip. May be shared across circuits.

Suggested fix (not applied): Compare against another green-theme circuit survey before touching Mugello; if Mugello-only, check terrain material blend near the ribbon.

5. Turn numbering disagrees between signs and the turns table

Where: scenery/mugello.js:651-654 (signBoard 1,6,9,15) vs mugello.js:75 turns[] (apexes: 15 strongest peaks; Arrabbiata R≈85–97 m at s 0.475–0.53 is not among them; turns[8]=0.5927 is Scarperia R≈38)

Seen: Sign 9 stands at s 0.495 (Arrabbiata) while the 9th entry of turns[] is at 0.593, so any HUD/sector logic keyed to turns[] mislabels T8–T15.

Suggested fix (not applied): Re-seat turns[] with the real 15 apexes (add Arrabbiata 1 and 2, drop 0.3857/0.6982/0.7137 duplicates) via tools/track/rotate-markings.cjs; do not hand-edit.

6. Clip audit: 5 severe spots (≥1.04 m) addBox×addCone

Where: clip-audit baseline 5 (cap 5): fracs 0.301 (1.15 m), 0.334 (1.15 m), 0.315 (1.11 m), 0.888 (1.07 m), 0.545 (1.04 m); minor 0.312, 0.894, 0.897

Seen: Cone foliage cutting through boxes near Casanova gravel/tyre wall (0.30–0.33), Bucine terrazza (0.89), and the Arrabbiata hill (0.545). Not visible in the captured frames.

Suggested fix (not applied): Extend openArea (:173-175) or dressingExclusions (mugello.js:33-36) to 0.296–0.336 and 0.884–0.900; or move the terrazza at :434/:444.

7. San Donato side −1 is stacked with four structures (suspected)

Where: terrazza :428 (gap 18, 9 rows ≈ out to 35 m), cameraTower :658 (gap 30), grandstandEx :667 (gap 36, 88 m), marshalPost :429

Seen: Footprints overlap by construction (terrazza reaches ~35 m, tower at 30 m, grandstand at 36 m). Not confirmed in a frame: f17 orbit shows only the terrazza and stand.

Suggested fix (not applied): Verify with a trackside shot at s 0.152; move the tower to gap ≥ 42 or drop it.

8. Pit complex is four separate bays, not a continuous canopy

Where: scenery/mugello.js:235-273 (4 bay groups, 42 m long at s 0.945/0.963/0.981/0.999 ≈ 94 m pitch) vs docs/tracks/mugello.md §4 'continuous roof over the garage row'

Seen: Eye f00 shows right-side blocks with gaps between them; real garage row is continuous.

Suggested fix (not applied): Increase bay count/length so the 0.945–0.999 span is covered, or add a connecting canopy box.

9. Night: only the car's lamp lights the scene

Where: mugello.js:76 furniture lamp 'none'; night:false (:27)

Seen: Night/dusk orbit frames: scenery outside the pit straight is dark; ground lit by a pool around the car. Plausible for a day-only venue but the game's night mode looks empty here.

Suggested fix (not applied): Optional: add floodlight masts along the pit straight and San Donato bowl via scenery-dress.

10. Engine observations (not Mugello code)

Where: js/lighting/atmosphere.js:444-466 overcast/fog branches; horizon flatten only for raceTimeOfDay 'default' (:454-457)

Seen: Overcast and fog frames keep a blue sky when captured with explicit --tod day; rain/storm foliage turns translucent; wet puddle mirror shows on grass and bare soil.

Suggested fix (not applied): Confirm with a 'default'-tod capture before filing; translucent foliage in rain needs a renderer-side look.

11. Stale header comment

Where: mugello.js:12-13 says the trace opens on a '682 m main straight'; brief and measured straight are ~1.14–1.18 km

Seen: Documentation only.

Suggested fix (not applied): Update the comment.
